Regional Football Pathways | Preparation guidance reviewed 18 October 2026
Recommended template, not a universal club requirement. Follow the receiving club’s instructions.
Replace bracketed text; delete irrelevant fields. Do not send this uncompleted template.

APPLICATION PACK CHECKLIST
Target club / pathway / age group: [details]
Source URL and date checked: [details]
Current season / deadline: [confirm; do not rely on historical notices]

FOR EACH ITEM, MARK:
Explicitly requested / Requested later / Recommended preparation / Not published

[ ] Correct application route and overseas eligibility questions identified
[ ] CV accurate, readable and tailored
[ ] Competition names, dates and statistics verified
[ ] Referee has approved assessment and consented to contact
[ ] Highlights identify player and show role-specific match evidence
[ ] Full matches and timestamp index available if requested
[ ] Recording, footage-use and sharing permissions checked
[ ] Links tested for intended reviewer
[ ] Fixtures included if requested, with time zone
[ ] Academic records prepared only where relevant
[ ] Held citizenship distinguished from pending applications
[ ] Parent/guardian involved for under-18 enquiries
[ ] Sensitive documents kept out of public profiles / unsolicited emails
[ ] Enquiry tailored; placeholders removed
[ ] Date sent, next action and response policy recorded

BEFORE TRAVEL
Confirm written invitation, eligibility for the actual activity, relevant club/association paperwork, supervision, accommodation, expenses, insurance and school arrangements.
Preparing documents does not establish eligibility or guarantee selection.
